example.a: The chocolate <m-yellow>had been</m-yellow> <m-blue>eaten</m-blue> before dinner was ready.
example.b: Die Schokolade war gegessen worden, bevor das Abendessen fertig war.
example.sound: The Chocolate had been eaten before dinner was ready.

instruction.text: Schreibe die Passivform des Verbs im past perfect in die Lücke.
instruction.sound: Schreibe die Passivform des Verbs im <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>past perfect</voice> in die Lücke.

atoms.b: The jeans ((had_been_bought)) before the clothes shop closed.
The orange juice ((had_been_drunk)) before it went bad.
